NAME: Whisp Taunt
DESCR: Agro enemy - locks it onto you for 1s then leaves you X aggro ahead, Power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged
DESCRIPTION: The whisp shrieks at an enemy — it turns on your master for a moment, and carries the grudge afterwards.

NAME: Whisp Charm
DESCR: Charms the enemy - start to walk thowards you for 3s then leaves you X aggro ahead, Power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged
DESCRIPTION: The whisp beguiles an enemy: for @{duration} it walks helplessly toward your master, and it remembers who called it.

NAME: Whisp Bind
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged
DESCRIPTION: The whisp pins an enemy to the ground for @{duration}.

NAME: Whisp Armor Break
DESCR: Decrease enemy P.Def and M.Def, Power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged

NAME: Whisp Weapon Break
DESCR: Decrease enemy P.Atk and M.Atk, Power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged

NAME: Whisp Gravity
DESCR: Decrease enemy Atack speed and cast speed, Power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), skill range condition to be met, If target is player - Pvp-On must be enabled and enemy must be flagged
DESCRIPTION: The whisp weighs an enemy down for @{duration}: slower attacks and slower casting.

NAME: Whisp Heal
DESCR: Heal master whose hp is higher than 50%, power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), Master HP must be between 50~99%
DESCRIPTION: The whisp mends its master while he is still on his feet.

NAME: Whisp Quick Heal
DESCR: Heal master whose HP is lower than 50%, power depends on whisp lvl
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), Master HP must be lower than 50%
DESCRIPTION: The whisp throws its master a fast heal when he is badly hurt.

NAME: Whisp Clear
DESCR: Removes up to 3 debuffs from master
Conditions: Master must be in combat mode (activley fighting), Master must have active debuff
DESCRIPTION: The whisp scours up to two afflictions off its master.
